subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album delivery be modeled as a new message-tool action/schema surface, or as grouped behavior inside the existing send/mediaUrls path?
rationale: This adds new user-facing message-tool capability and the linked draft PR proposes a new action plus filePaths schema, so maintainers need to choose the permanent tool contract before implementation proceeds.

options.title: Group eligible mediaUrls in send
options.body: Use the existing send/mediaUrls path and call sendMediaGroup only when Telegram can form an eligible album, keeping one canonical message-send action.

options.title: Adopt a new album action
options.body: Accept a send-media-group/filePaths style action after review, docs, and live Telegram proof make the new contract explicit.

options.title: Defer album delivery
options.body: Keep sequential media delivery for now and leave grouped albums out until a maintainer sponsors the product direction.

recommendation.title: Group eligible mediaUrls in send
recommendation.body: Use the existing send/mediaUrls path and call sendMediaGroup only when Telegram can form an eligible album, keeping one canonical message-send action.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and has recent Telegram action/media-send history, making him the best available routing candidate for the product-shape decision.
